name: R_user_dir
title: A per-user directory for a package

origin.description: data, config, or cache under the XDG paths on Linux.
origin.details: R_USER_DATA_DIR, R_USER_CONFIG_DIR, and R_USER_CACHE_DIR win, then the XDG variables, then ~/.local/share, ~/.config, and ~/.cache. The package name is added after an R directory.

translation.description: data, config, or cache under the XDG paths on Linux.
translation.details: R_USER_DATA_DIR, R_USER_CONFIG_DIR, and R_USER_CACHE_DIR win, then the XDG variables, then ~/.local/share, ~/.config, and ~/.cache. The package name is added after an R directory.
translation.example:
import os
os.environ.pop("R_USER_DATA_DIR", None)
os.environ.pop("XDG_DATA_HOME", None)
print(R_user_dir("backports"))
